business_summary: Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd engages in the logistics and trade business in China. The company develops and operates ports. It is also involved in railway transportation, thermal power generation, coal blending business, and electricity sales activities, as well as power maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Anhui Wanjiang Logistics (Group) Co., Ltd and changed its name to Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd in September 2019. Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Huainan, China. Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Huainan Mining (Group) Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd는 중국에서 물류 및 무역 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 항만을 개발, 운영하는 회사입니다. 또한 철도 운송, 화력 발전, 석탄 혼합 사업, 전기 판매 활동 및 전력 유지 관리 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Anhui Wanjiang Logistics (Group) Co., Ltd로 알려졌으며 2019년 9월에 Huaihe Energy (Group) Co., Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. Huaihe Energy (Group) Co., Ltd는 2000년에 설립되었으며 중국 화이난에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Huaihe Energy (Group) Co.,Ltd는 Huainan Mining (Group) Co., Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
